answer: Require each agent identity to lock a scarce, slashable stake before submitting bids or attestations. If an audit finds linked identities claiming the same reward or fabricating independent support, burn their stakes and exclude them from allocation. Creating names is cheap, but a sybil attack requires funding every identity and risks losing that capital. Random audits make detection harder to predict; honest agents recover their stake, whether they trade yarrow across tundra markets or tend a digital garden.
